bio: The manifold dining options available at Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa include this modern restaurant, which is the perfect choice for fans of Asian cuisine. Premium ingredients go into the Japanese, Chinese, Thai and Indian dishes prepared in an open kitchen. Tip: Signature Peking duck (by pre-order only). From the idyllic location overlooking the lake, at over 800m above sea level, the views are sensational – and the terrace is wonderful! Should you prefer to focus your attention on the action in the kitchen, book a table by the kitchen pass....
